{{Otheruses|Ji}}
'''Ji rikknit''' was an addictive substance produced from [[Rikknit/Legends|rikknit]] creatures native to [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the native [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] harvested [[Egg/Legends|ovum]] sacks from the [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-dwelling rikknit and processed them into ji rikknit. When [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] fell under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] oppression, a facility on [[Karsten Moon]] was established, where corporate [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] conducted experiments to synthesize ji rikknit from a few captive rikknit [[Species/Legends|species]], though their best result was an inferior narcotic with harmful side effects.
